snippet.title: Space Station Designer | Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Space Station Designer is a construction and management game where you become the CEO of a private aerospace company, in charge of creating and operating a thriving network of orbital outposts.

Begin with a single core module in Low Earth orbit and gradually extend your operations into higher Earth and Lunar orbits. Design self-sustaining stations, manage astronauts and logistics, unlock advanced technologies, and help shape humanity’s space economy. 
Your ultimate ambition? Construct and operate a Lunar Space Elevator Megaproject.

Prepare yourselves for the full release: the game launches on November 18.

🎮 Play now on Steam ➡️ https://store.steampowered.com/app/1447650/Space_Station_Designer/
💬 Join the Discord Server ➡️ https://discord.gg/xY5arQVtkG
🦎 More info on Slitherine ➡️ https://www6.slitherine.com/game/space-station-designer
